notes.title: Go beyond SAND LAND and continue into FOREST LAND!
notes.content:
[h2]This [b]new world and characters[/b] have been imagined [b]by creator Akira Toriyama specifically for the video game and animated series[/b], expanding the [i]world of SAND LAND with new adventures[/i].[/h2]

[previewyoutube=R-QLnmBpw-k;full][/previewyoutube]
Beyond [b]the dunes and the scorching desert sun[/b], lies a [b]lush and green nation called FOREST LAND[/b]. Although peaceful at first glance, this place is [b]governed by a ferocious army[/b] opposing SAND LAND. Leading this force is [b]Muniel, fearsome despite his childlike features[/b], he is determined to save his land by [b]getting his hands on a supply of Aquanium[/b], a powerful but dangerous resource, and [b]he will not back down without a fight[/b].

notes.title: Get an in-depth overview of SAND LAND's gameplay!
notes.content:
[h2]Step into a world where your adventure is dictated by [b]your bravery and imagination[/b]![/h2]

[h3]We've got [b]everything you need to know[/b] to be ready [i]starting Day One to traverse the desert[/i] and [i]come out on top[/i] in this Gameplay Overview video.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=wzTwbX8E7t8;full][/previewyoutube]
In a distant future, [b]humans and demons live together[/b] in a desertic world deprived of water: [b]the SAND LAND[/b]. To restore balance to the world, the [b]Fiend Prince Beelzebub forms a strange trio with his chaperone Thief and the human Sheriff Rao[/b]. Together, they will [b]set off on an epic journey[/b], in search of [b]the Legendary Spring[/b].

[h3]Click [url=https://bnent.eu/SandLandGameplay][b]HERE[/b][/url] or [b]on the visual below[/b] to get the full details:[/h3]

notes.title: Dive into the desert world with unique characters!
notes.content:
[h3]The [b]son of Lucifer[/b], the [b]king of demons[/b], [b]Beelzebub is the Fiend Prince[/b] who [i]enjoys video games and machines[/i].[/h3]
He is a [b]self-proclaimed "evil demon"[/b] who [i]plays pranks but never kills people[/i] as he actually [b]has a heart of gold[/b]. He has [b]physical abilities that are unmatched by humans[/b] as well as [b]telephathic abilities[/b] that allow him to [b]read peoples minds and speak directly into their mind[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/696de0a009094f108f37f541be23a29ccf92ab76.png[/img]
[h3][b]Rao[/b], an [b]elderly sheriff[/b].[/h3]
Although he is [b]only a human[/b], he has a [b]strong sense of justice[/b] and [b]sets out on a journey to find the Legendary Spring to save the people of Sand Land[/b] that [i]suffer from the extreme water shortage[/i]. [b]Extremely skilled[/b] in his tonfas, [b]Rao fights with the strength of a man in his prime[/b]. He is also [b]skilled in handling tanks[/b], perhaps [i]due to previous experience[/i]... It seems he is [b]holding some secrets[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/e5c62d3cea430a49e45ec4e58ff5686e4713e6ab.png[/img]
[h3][b]Thief, Beelzebub's chaperone demon[/b].[/h3] 
He is [b]good at stealing and has a worldly sense[/b]. He has [i]knowledge of various things[/i] that happened in [b]Sand Land[/b]. [b]Thief is a little older than Beelzebub[/b] and his appearance is that of an old man, but [b]he has a young curiosity about him[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/e4595d946816c82965e93a12e7c716f3b65fafd1.png[/img]

notes.title: Check out the SAND LAND Story Trailer with English dub!

notes.title: Dive into a legendary desert world!
notes.content:
[h3]Dive into a desert world where both humans and demons suffer from an extreme water shortage. Play as and watch the [b]Fiend Prince, Beelzebub[/b], [b]Sheriff Rao[/b], and demon [b]Thief[/b] set off on an adventure in search of a [b]Legendary Spring[/b] hidden in the desert.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=JbKjqVtthPk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Playing as Beelzebub, players will be able to explore a vast world accompanied by his unlikely group of demons and humans. Whether roaming in various vehicles, or traveling by foot, players will encounter dangers as well as helpful characters they meet in the vast desert while uncovering SAND LAND’s many secrets. Players will have access to a variety of vehicles that they can customize and equip with loadouts to traverse the desert, overcome obstacles, and take on a diverse assortment of mighty foes.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979440/SAND_LAND/
